MISSING_TERMS:
['Release of Claims': The borrower's release of all past claims against the lenders (as detailed in Section 4 of the source document) is a material term of the agreement that is not mentioned in the memo.]

{"has_issues": true, "issues": ["The memo lists 'Borrower confirmation of no existing Default or Event of Default as of consent date' (September 15, 2023) as a key strength, which contradicts the fact that the consent agreement exists to extend a financial reporting deadline that was missed on March 31, 2023. Missing this deadline would constitute a default, meaning a default was in fact existing on the consent date."]}
